description: Declared pre-existing test failures recorded on the audit HEAD. Consumed by run_tests.ps1 -Baseline to separate the Phase 0 required gate from the full historical regression matrix. These entries NEVER change a case status: the runner keeps reporting FAIL (status/exit/counts are not renamed, hidden or skipped); it only classifies each failure as known+expected vs new/drift.

evidence_provenance: Report-provided baseline evidence, NOT independently re-executed from the audit HEAD in the CI environment. The counts below come from the verifier's independent baseline run (T4), docs/54 section 2.1, and the Phase 0 PR-head re-run, which agree item by item. CI treats this file as a declared baseline only; it does not prove those failures are acceptable — they are content/contract drift that Phase 0 explicitly does not fix.
